stories.title: Bitcoin Tests $78.3K Support as Dollar Weakens and Oil Rallies
stories.summary: Bitcoin slipped after failing to hold $80,000 over the weekend and now faces a support test near $78,300. Options traders are buying bullish calls even as spot sellers keep offloading coins. US crude oil hit a three-month high, and a weaker dollar this week may not deliver the liquidity rally bulls want.
stories.whyItMatters: Price action at a key support level affects leveraged positions and sentiment, and the split between options buyers and spot sellers is worth tracking.
whatToWatch: Whether $78.3K holds as support this week
Dollar index moves and any liquidity signals from central banks
Gap between options positioning and spot selling
questions: Does a weaker dollar actually bring fresh crypto liquidity?
Is the call-buying a real bullish bet or just a hedge?

sources.title: Bitcoin bulls are loading up on calls while spot traders keep selling
Bitcoin could get the dollar drop bulls want this week without getting the liquidity rally they need
Bitcoin faces key support test at $78.3K as US crude oil hits three-month high

stories.title: Franklin Templeton Digital Asset Veteran Named Head of StablecoinX
stories.summary: A digital-asset executive from Franklin Templeton has taken over leadership of StablecoinX, Cointelegraph reported. The report did not disclose details on the executive's mandate or StablecoinX's plans.
stories.whyItMatters: Hires from major asset managers into stablecoin ventures point to continued institutional interest in the sector.
whatToWatch: Any strategy announcements from StablecoinX under the new leader
questions: What is StablecoinX's business model and market position?
What changes will the new leader make?

sources.title: Franklin Templeton digital asset veteran takes helm at StablecoinX

stories.title: New York Town Weighs Ban on Crypto Mining and AI Data Centers
stories.summary: A town in New York is considering a ban on crypto mining and AI data center operations, Cointelegraph reported. The move reflects local pushback against energy-intensive computing facilities.
stories.whyItMatters: Local bans can restrict where miners operate and add to the patchwork of US rules the industry already faces.
whatToWatch: The town's vote or decision timeline
Whether nearby municipalities consider similar measures
questions: What is driving the town's concern: energy costs, noise, or emissions?
Which existing miners or facilities would the ban affect?

sources.title: New York town weighs crypto mining and AI data center ban

stories.title: Strategy's $250 Bitcoin-Branded Jordans Sell Out
stories.summary: A $250 Bitcoin-themed Jordan sneaker tied to Michael Saylor's Strategy sold out, CryptoSlate reported. Strategy holds a large share of global Bitcoin supply, and the sneaker drop marks a push into consumer branding.
stories.whyItMatters: It is a marketing curiosity rather than a fundamental development, but it shows how far corporate Bitcoin treasuries are stretching their brands.
whatToWatch: Whether Strategy pursues further consumer merchandise
questions: Does this branding push affect Strategy's core Bitcoin treasury strategy?

sources.title: Strategy’s $250 Bitcoin Jordans sold out as Saylor turns 4% of BTC supply into a consumer brand

stories.title: Visa Adds Onchain Credit to Its Stablecoin Card Business
stories.summary: Visa is expanding its stablecoin card program with an onchain credit feature, Cointelegraph reported. The addition builds on Visa's existing stablecoin-linked card offerings.
stories.whyItMatters: Visa's continued build-out shows traditional payment rails integrating stablecoins more deeply, which could widen mainstream use.
whatToWatch: Rollout timeline and which markets get access first
Partner banks or card issuers involved
questions: Which stablecoins will back the credit feature?
How will Visa handle credit risk and compliance?

sources.title: Visa brings onchain credit to its growing stablecoin card business

stories.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Adds $70M in Ethereum, Holdings Reach 5.93M ETH
stories.summary: Bitmine, chaired by Tom Lee, bought another $70 million in Ethereum, Decrypt reported. The purchase brings its total holdings to 5.93 million ETH.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitmine's large corporate ETH treasury makes its buying and holding patterns a factor in Ethereum market sentiment.
whatToWatch: Further disclosed purchases and total holdings growth
Any comments from Lee on strategy
questions: What is funding Bitmine's continued purchases?
At what point does this concentration become a market risk?

sources.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Adds $70 Million in Ethereum, Holdings Reach 5.93 Million ETH

stories.title: Metaplanet's Bitcoin Rally Turns Executive Pay Plan Into a Massive Windfall
stories.summary: A rise in Metaplanet's Bitcoin holdings turned a 46-million-share executive pay plan into one worth 319 million shares, CryptoSlate reported.
stories.whyItMatters: The scale of this payout increase shows how corporate Bitcoin treasury strategies can supercharge executive pay, raising governance questions for shareholders.
whatToWatch: Any shareholder reaction or governance review of the pay plan
Metaplanet's continued pace of Bitcoin accumulation
questions: What vesting conditions govern the pay plan?
Do shareholders have any recourse to revisit its terms?

sources.title: Metaplanet’s Bitcoin boom quietly turned a 46 million-share executive pay plan into a 319 million-share windfall

stories.title: Visa Turns to Onchain Lending to Fund Stablecoin Card Programs
stories.summary: Visa is using onchain lending to help finance its stablecoin card programs, Decrypt reported. The approach pairs its stablecoin card push with a financing mechanism drawn from onchain lending markets.
stories.whyItMatters: Pairing onchain lending with card issuance shows a major payment company tapping crypto-native infrastructure beyond stablecoins alone.
whatToWatch: Which lending protocols or partners Visa uses
Scale of the financing and which issuers benefit
questions: Is this lending sourced from public DeFi protocols or private onchain facilities?
What risk terms apply to issuers relying on this financing?

sources.title: Visa Taps Onchain Lending to Finance Stablecoin Card Programs

stories.title: Strive Buys $109M in Bitcoin, Preferred Stock Offering Nears $1 Billion
stories.summary: Strive purchased $109 million in Bitcoin, Decrypt reported. The purchase comes as the company pushes its preferred stock offering toward $1 billion.
stories.whyItMatters: It is another corporate treasury using preferred stock to fund Bitcoin purchases, a financing model Strategy pioneered.
whatToWatch: Completion of the $1 billion preferred stock raise
Strive's total Bitcoin holdings after this purchase
questions: What yield and terms does the preferred stock carry?
How does Strive's balance-sheet risk compare to peers using similar financing?

sources.title: Strive Buys $109 Million in Bitcoin, Pushes Preferred Stock Toward $1 Billion

stories.title: Strategy Skips Bitcoin Purchase to Repurchase $176M of STRC Preferred Shares
stories.summary: Strategy did not buy additional Bitcoin this period, Cointelegraph reported. Instead, the company repurchased $176 million of its STRC preferred shares.
stories.whyItMatters: A pause in buying from the largest corporate Bitcoin holder is notable, and prioritizing the buyback suggests balance-sheet management came first this period.
whatToWatch: Whether Strategy resumes Bitcoin purchases next cycle
STRC preferred share price and yield after the buyback
questions: Why did Strategy prioritize the buyback over more Bitcoin this period?
Does this signal any funding constraint?

sources.title: Strategy skips Bitcoin buy to repurchase $176M of STRC preferred shares

stories.title: Shrinking Dollar Reserve Share Doesn't Mean Central Banks Are Buying Bitcoin
stories.summary: An analysis from CryptoSlate warns against reading a decline in the dollar's share of global reserves as evidence that central banks are buying Bitcoin. The piece pushes back on a popular bullish narrative in crypto circles.
stories.whyItMatters: It is a useful check on a common bullish talking point, and readers should separate real central bank Bitcoin demand from broader dollar reserve trends.
whatToWatch: Any actual central bank disclosures of Bitcoin holdings
Future data on global reserve composition
questions: What is actually driving the shift away from dollar reserves, if not Bitcoin?
Which central banks, if any, hold Bitcoin today?

sources.title: Why Bitcoin bulls shouldn’t mistake a shrinking dollar reserve share for central bank buying

stories.title: $47M Still Missing After Liquid Hack as Blockstream Negotiates With 'White Hats'
stories.summary: About $47 million remains unrecovered following a hack of the Liquid exchange, Decrypt reported. Blockstream is negotiating with parties described as "white hats" in an effort to recover the funds.
stories.whyItMatters: Unresolved exchange hacks and recovery negotiations affect user trust and set precedent for how firms handle stolen-fund recovery.
whatToWatch: Outcome of the negotiations with the white hats
Whether any funds are returned and on what terms
questions: Are the "white hats" the original attackers or unrelated third parties?
How much of the $47 million, if any, will be recovered?

sources.title: $47M Still Missing After Liquid Hack as Blockstream Bargains With 'White Hats'
